decisions.reason: The source establishes the separate View Book action and its ownership-based visibility; the cover sizing requirement remains unchanged and already has same-message runtime verification.
Showing a View Book action to the NFT owner does not change the metadata fields or the existing gated-viewer link target.
The NFT-detail book-access action has no effect on the token standard, marketplace policy, or secondary-sale royalty.
The detail-page access action does not alter the unlimited-mint NFT ebook collection model.
Ownership-based visibility of the View Book action does not change which NFT entitlements or state transfer to a secondary buyer.
The source action applies on an NFT detail page and does not change the rule for listing or counting successfully minted NFTs on the dashboard.
The source changes a detail-page action rather than any FAQ copy or FAQ behavior.
The View Book label and visibility rule do not alter referral-code identity, display surfaces, sharing methods, or resale behavior.
The source concerns a View Book action on the NFT detail page, not the landing-page cover's placement, size, or visibility.
The NFT-detail View Book action is distinct from the certificate email's named read button, PDF.js action, and optional download link.
The book-access action does not affect prize-winner announcement or notification channels.
The source does not revise any About-page copy, process item, technology item, feature item, or vision content.
